_comment: Single source of truth for every color and type decision in the PDF
report, the methodology paper, and the Streamlit site (handoff B-1).
No hex codes may appear anywhere outside this file; the smoke test
greps for strays. Role guide: ink/paper are text/background, pine is
the ONE brand green (heads, links, positive bars, validated claims),
clay is negative/failure, slate is captions and secondary text, tint
is zebra striping and panel fills, flag gold is RESERVED for
speculative or failed-validation content and is never decorative.
Light palette only (author direction 2026-08-18: dark mode removed).

tiers._comment: 5-step pine-to-tint scale for tier bands (Leading cluster first)

fonts.note: tabular-lining figures mandatory in every numeric column

type_scale_pdf._comment: B-1 scale (pt): applied to the report in PR 3
